Hi Marta —

Hope you had a good week. I’m following up on Invoice INV-20421 (due 10/05) — we need to lock the payment window to ensure the scheduled capacity credits are applied on your account next month. At present we show a pending ACH instruction, but AP is asking for either: (A) confirmation of the wire date and beneficiary details, or (B) updated card authorization if wire is not possible.

Two quick asks so we can avoid an interruption:
- Please confirm whether Novaforge will wire on Mon 10/04 (beneficiary: Redwood Inference LLC — Bank ref: 9887412). If yes, reply with the expected value date and bank reference.
- If you prefer card, we can accept a virtual card today — let us know and we’ll send a secure payment link.

Note: You previously indicated an entity split for VAT reporting (Novaforge EU entity vs Novaforge US). To make sure funds route to the correct ledger and VAT handling, we need your AP team to confirm which entity is paying for INV-20421. If we don’t get an entity confirmation before the payment date, we may need to hold the invoice for tax validation which could delay application of credits.

I’ve attached the invoice and a copy of our W-9 for your records.

(attachment: Invoice_INV-20421.pdf (application/pdf))
(attachment: W9_Oct2027.pdf (application/pdf))

Appreciate a short confirmation — if it helps, I’m available for a 15-min call this afternoon.

Best,
Olga
